description: Send one message to a business's customer on the channel you choose: a text (sms) from one of the business's agent lines, or a WhatsApp message from its connected WhatsApp number. The same consent, Do-Not-Call, quiet-hours and rate gates as the dashboard apply, and a refusal says which one. sms needs from_agent_id; whatsapp needs a number the owner connected to WhatsApp (pass from when there is more than one) and a customer who messaged that number in the last 24 hours. Email is not sent here; draft_email_campaign drafts a campaign the owner reviews and approves. business_id is required when the account has more than one business. The result reports that the provider accepted the message, not that it was delivered.

business_id.description: The business sending. Required when the account has more than one.

from.description: whatsapp only: the business's connected WhatsApp number, when it has more than one.

from_agent_id.description: sms only (required): the agent whose phone line sends the text.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key. Completed replays return the original send. New keyed WhatsApp requests reserve a durable intent before dispatch. Uncertain or concurrent replays are refused, and a new key is treated as a new send. Legacy lost receipts remain unverified.

lead_id.description: Optional lead ID to link and honor the lead's automation-pause state.

name: send_message
title: Send Message
